snippet.title: Satellite Odyssey: Prologue - Gameplay Trailer - Retrofuturistic SciFi Game - Soviet Space Station
snippet.description:
Satellite Odyssey: Prologue —  is a narrative-driven sci-fi thriller set in a retro-futuristic vision of space exploration. You play as Laska, a Soviet robopsychologist, who wakes from cryosleep only to find that something on the station has gone terribly wrong... 🚀

🎮About the Developers:
Satellite Odyssey: Prologue was created by Antifreeze Games, a small but dedicated indie team passionate about science fiction and storytelling. We believe in making heartfelt, atmospheric games that combine immersive worlds with meaningful narratives. Satellite Odyssey: Prologue is our first released project, and we're excited to share it with players around the world.

🔔 Subscribe for more updates as we continue our journey through the stars with the next chapter: Satellite Odyssey: Jupiter — a full-scale survival adventure coming soon!
